label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Ternil et Gorndholm
english: I.4 · The Rite of the Cornerstone

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Heth hosast et tynur.
english: *The first spring of the siege.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Seren Pa Luth, sullast odh Halyna. Ul et gemmnoth vess re yalom tev et Stonwrytan, eth nath re oskant galat lom veth et nynth.
english: *Laid by Seren Two-Inks, the third of the hearth of {{Halyna}}. In the Fourteen Nights I was a child of the guild, and they trusted me with naught but water.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren. Myskym o lom gor fedh.
english: Hold the stone, Seren. I tell myself so every time.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess sullast ul sestow et carm, re varr baegyth, eth re rynnym. Re yal Rhyna rynnet, eth ul et hoss sost re rik Halvard et greller. Nath re harmom. Re orr et baegyth hyom dem vimm, kylyl um hylyl, dem drod ul nynth.
english: On the third night after the cry a light moved, and I woke. Rhyna was risen, and in the same breath Halvard took up the lamp. I called not out. Down from me the light went, turning by turning, till it was a spark in a well.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um sona hos tevow re vell odha Hyna vell dhesketh Aldwena, eth o haeveret, re vess nahos o:
english: Over their one cradle Rhyna's mother had sung the rhyme of {{Aldwena}}'s line, and what it meant, none had asked:

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: Ul vimm et hellur, ul vimm et pressir,
english:
*Under the hall and under the floor,*
*under the stair that goes no more,*
*down where the rope let the first stone go,*
*the first two keep what the first two know.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: ul vimm et bystir sa hess,
english:
*Under the hall and under the floor,*
*under the stair that goes no more,*
*down where the rope let the first stone go,*
*the first two keep what the first two know.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: dem vimm, ul vodh re lusk et bunth et tolm hosast,
english:
*Under the hall and under the floor,*
*under the stair that goes no more,*
*down where the rope let the first stone go,*
*the first two keep what the first two know.*

label: Romanisation · the verse
rom: kethe pa hosast galat sa seske pa hosast.
english:
*Under the hall and under the floor,*
*under the stair that goes no more,*
*down where the rope let the first stone go,*
*the first two keep what the first two know.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vimm et bystir sa re hess, re sesk Rhyna ul vodh dem veskyl, eth re orr Halvard dem vimm ul et myger. Re lusk ey et bunth, eth nath re vyske sona hos brod.
english: Under the stair that went no more, Rhyna wist where to look, and down the shaft went Halvard. She paid out the rope, and neither spake a word.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo visk, hosen re wrodha Halyna o lom, re ston vestul hy dholm domm, eth tuss um o waek, gunn hosen nind. Re nalymm Halvard et tuss lo o hovvel.
english: At the foot, as they told it me, stood a chest of black stone, the dust a finger deep on its lid. Halvard swept it with his sleeve.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew rellor Aldwena.
english: It was the mark of {{Aldwena}}.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ulo re sol et Ternil um halflenneth, halflenneth yaldol dem stemir, ryt surr et galdardath hosast, eth hulter lo dhrenn et pressir. Ul et gorn re ston sull hellenn hy dholm. Re varr Halvard gor hos hyont lo et greller.
english: Within lay the Rite on leaves of slate, the slates of building for battle, the founders' annal, and along the floor a staff. In the corner stood three stone flasks. Halvard shook each by the lamp.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re varr nayalat ulont.
english: Naught moved in them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et vorr re veske Halyna et halflenneth dem so haeveret, trenn eth hoss eth trenn, eth re hadhom et nunth, eth re nadhumom o.
english: At the fire {{Halyna}} read the slates for their meaning, a line and a breath and a line, and I set my bucket down and forgat it.

label: Romanisation
rom: El sy Ternil et Gorndholm,
english: "This is the Rite of the Cornerstone,"

label: Romanisation
rom: sa hadhar ketherd um yaldat strom lo, dem o dhaldol eth dem o hethyl, dem o stonol.
english: "by which a keeper is set over a great work, to raise it and to keep it, till it stand."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ston haral et hulter vimm hyo.
english: Lower stood the law of the staff.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss hulter stinet dem o yaldat, eth nath morr o hyo,
english: "A staff is cut for its work, and leaveth not its work,"

label: Romanisation
rom: eth amm doss et galdat galdat, doss et hulter cadhat ulo.
english: "and when the work is done, the staff is laid down in it."

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et halflenneth vimm hyont re sell et hoss ul lodh et trenneth. Hald ferret dem gylyl vedh. Ganna ferret ul lern et stromrunn. Trenn cadhat sa omm vathur ulo hyvenn. Re seskent et galdardath hosast gorrol. Ul lern vodh, nel rytet um et halflenneth.
english: At the slates beneath, the breath between the lines grew long. Walls sloped to turn a shot. Gates set crooked against the ram. Courses laid that a breach should fall outward. The first builders had known war. Against what, the slates say not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss maver sull lernul um et Ternil, sa re yald nahos hossen.
english: Three oils the Rite must have, that none living had made.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem et maress, re nesk Stannard Halyna lo dhrenn et sulv dem et meskan ul vodh re yal et hulter hosast rytet. Nath re yostant mesk hossen. Um et mesk ommat re runn Stannard lo o nind, eth re rern o.
english: For the cedar, Stannard led {{Halyna}} through the snow to the stand where the first staff was cut. A living tree would they not fell. On the fallen trunks Stannard knocked with his knuckle, and listened.

label: Romanisation
rom: Seskym vodh hyont es geth.
english: "I know which of these will hold."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wamma Halyna lernul hy et meskvolt lo et odh sy, eth ul vess thenth hossant tolmath et odh o tul.
english: They rendered the heartwood at this hearth, and on a wet night its stones breathe it out yet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Sinth, vollant et tolmardath et sast stacorn um dholm dasorat sa re yal navothat tesk eth tesk, hy vodh el sinth o ul vodh mellor nahos.
english: Bloom the masons call the pale crust on worked stone untended for lives of men, for it flowereth where none come.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re vellorar, et tevath, lo wresketh hemm, eth re ferrer lo dhrenn et tolmath nadhumat hosen derrerdeth lo dhrenn derrow derret. Ew ull et pyskorn hosast hebbet lom sa new nynth.
english: Then came we children with old chisels, and bent along the forgotten stones as gleaners along a stubble-field. It was the first work given me that was not water.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal nindeth nasastat lom hyo.
english: My fingers were raw with it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re yal hebbyl styvess lo et brunn. Re lymme Idrenna hos hellenn lo dhrenn et orrol tunn, dem muldath sennet et Stonwrytan. Um et hiskenn, nath re rik et trun so. Amm re dhaedh Rhyna et styvess ul et maress, re yal et hellur velv, hosen doss orrol velv dem et uld sennet. Lo styvess uldath sennet et orrol, es noss et Crenn lernulat.
english: The myrrh the mountain could not give. One flask had {{Idrenna}} carried the whole road, for the dead of the guild. On the pass the ground would not take them. When Rhyna warmed the gum into the cedar, the hall fell quiet, as a street doth for a bier. With the myrrh of the road's dead the Captain would be anointed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re seskym cedh sa re yal o lymmet demo.
english: I wist for whom it had been carried.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et vess, re ston hellenn Idrenna pondul um et odhdholm, eth re femm nahos hyor o. Desir re vellor et Crenn hy et hald, lodh dem et sestyarl, eth re vesk o umo, eth pawast re orr o.
english: All night the flask of {{Idrenna}} stood empty on the hearthstone, and none of us would touch it. Late came the Captain in off the wall, mortar to the wrist, and looked on it, and went out again.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et orl gemmnothast, re vellor rerd bynt, et hosast hy et movenn. Ul et parow re sol et hosk clenn sa re stann Stannard, eth re rasora Orvenna. Lo o sest re reske Idrenna, eth et hellenneth um sona simm. Re ston et Crenn ul vodh re haral et halflenn et nenderd dem stonol, eth o yarl um et tolm, eth o lern dem et lunt.
english: On the fourteenth day came a thin sun, the first since the banner. In the ward lay the new capstone that Stannard had quarried and {{Orvenna}} dressed. Beside it sat {{Idrenna}} with the flasks in their laps. The Captain stood where the slate bade the overseer stand, his hand on the stone and his face to the people.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re vall o ull. Re ston o lo ull.
english: He did not like it. He stood there.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et ganna re wemm et covv treskat hos fedh, eth re omm o. Re hunnom et crestnynth ul haskol ul et praevarath hemm.
english: Above the gate the torn cloak lifted once, and fell. I heard the snow-water running in the old gutters.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re dhalda Idrenna, hos ul ferryl um sest ullen, eth lo yemm garl hemm re ferre gor hellenn um o wisk ferret. Ul et grem ull re varrant sona yarlath um gor yalat ullen. Um et hellenneth nath re varrant.
english: Then {{Idrenna}} rose, the one leaning on the other, and with their four old hands tipped each flask over his bowed head. That winter their hands shook at everything else. On the flasks they shook not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re voll hos gor lernul, eth ullen o haeveret:
english: The one named each oil, and the other its meaning:

label: Romanisation
rom: Maress, dem hydull. Kyvilsinth, dem mylenn. Styvess, dem havul hrennyth.
english: "Cedar, for endurance. Granite-bloom, for strength. Myrrh, for the burden of command."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hask et lernul ul o hovv, eth re lusk o ull. Re wemmer, et tevath ul lern, ol narlath nasastat hos um ullen, eth re yal hylenn umor, ul et fedh hosast hy et hiskenneth.
english: The oil ran into his collar, and he wiped it not. We children at the front held up our raw hands to one another, and smiled, for the first time since the passes.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hethe Idrenna hulter et Stonwrytan dem lern. Hosen sy voll et halflenn o: hulter hy vesk dasorat, hoskat lo dholm dasorat, et gell sost, sa re lymm gor nenderd yaldat strom et Stonwrytan hy et rivull. Ew et hulter hosast sost. Re vesk et Crenn umo fedh sell, eth hy ull re sell o yarlath.
english: {{Idrenna}} held out the staff of the guild. The slate nameth it so: *a rod of polished wood capped with the finest polished ashlar, borne by every overseer of a great Stonewright work since the founding*. It was the first staff of all. A long while the Captain looked on it ere he put out his hands.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadhant gemm garl o, eth re rike pa yarl o.
english: Four hands laid it in two.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et hulter re yal o vollat Ketherd Hethow Dhresk, eth re ston o sol ul et bontoth.
english: By it he was named Commander of Rivenkeep, and stood still in the noise.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess ull re hethym et greller somm re ryte Halyna sona rellor eth sona Stonwryt ul vimm et tolm clenn. Re hadh hos et bresk, eth re runn ullen. Nath noss lunn lom dem rytyl sona rellor. Lo sest et Stonwryt re ryte brodath sa nel ryt, rytet hy et covv, stinel eth stinel.
english: That night I held the lamp while {{Halyna}} cut their mark and their vow under the new stone. The one set the chisel, and the other struck. Their mark is not mine to draw. Beside the vow they cut words that are not a vow, copied from the cloak stroke for stroke.

label: Romanisation · the Title
rom: Ul dumol ol varn, ol theldeth, ol Mardh, ol lunnath, ol sollan.
english: **IN MEMORY OF OUR HOME, OUR FAMILIES, OUR GOD, OUR FREEDOMS, OUR PEACE.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew garl et Crenn, strom eth niss.
english: It was the Captain's hand, large and slow.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re hlenne sona hos stinel.
english: Neither of them had mended one stroke.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wemment et vennuldath et tolm ul et ganna, et rellor dem vimm. Ul norn et gannalest re ferr et Crenn et hulter, hy vodh ew o yaldat et hald eth et gorrol. Re orr o dem et hald pawast, eth saed hovv um o sestow.
english: The True Men raised the stone into the gate, mark down. In the gatehouse corner the Captain leaned the staff, for his work was the wall and the war. To the wall he went again, his half of a cloak on his back.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re varr nahos et hulter. Amm bethirys et trenn, orra, eth veska um et tuss umo.
english: No one hath moved the staff. If you doubt the tale, go and look at the dust on it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re yal et tolm cadhat, eth et garleleth midhet, re luska Halyna en dem vimm hosel lo et greller, dem gadhol et halflenneth pawast. Re orrom dem vimm, kylyl um hylyl, ul vodh re nendym sona waegyth ul morrol. Re wemmym et hellenneth pondul.
english: When the stone was set and the tools were cleaned, {{Halyna}} sent me down alone with the lamp to lay the slates back. Down I went, turning by turning, where I had watched their light go. I lifted the empty flasks.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal hos flenn tul.
english: There was one leaf more.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal o dholmath strom eth vothen, hosen doss tolmath dhev, eth hosen doss en dolmath tul. Re lymmym o dem susk ul vimm en govv, eth re yal o brid umom. Lo et vorr re veske Halyna o lom: flenn et prassel tevel sost, ul et orlath hosast.
english: Its letters were large and careful, as a child's are, and as mine are yet. I carried it up inside my shirt, cold against my skin. At the fire {{Halyna}} read it me: the leaf of the youngest apprentice of the First Days.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm doss et tolm cadhat, eth et garleleth midhet, resker lo et odh, eth cadh hos hyor trenn,
english: "When the stone is set and the tools are cleaned, we sit at the hearth, and one of us layeth a tale."

label: Romanisation
rom: hosen doss trenn cadhat um hald, hos trenn gor vess, hy ull talda et hald eth et brodhol olen.
english: "As a course is laid on a wall, one course each night, so the wall and the telling rise together."

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull doss et odh sy hemm hy et cummath. Nath re yaldar o. Re nadhumar o, eth re wesker o lo vimmow vestul pawast.
english: So this hearth is older than the havens. We made it not. We forgat it, and found it again at the bottom of a chest.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess fennet re ston Kael, hy vodh re nahebb o reskyl, eth re hadh o et trenn hosast. Re yal o um et Crenn.
english: The next night Kael stood, for he would not sit, and laid the first tale. It was of the Captain.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re harm et lunt o: Ketherd. Ul o volt sost, ew tul hosel et Crenn o.
english: The people called him Commander. In his own heart he was still only the Captain.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Vollol et Treskan
english: I.5 · The Naming of the Rivenmen

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et grem vranast, hedh et orrol dem vimm.
english: *The sixth winter, the eve of the going-down.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Voss sa re vess, hy Dhavow Hemm, vennuld wramman et tavow, sa re dhev ul davowlest o scaelur um et tavow.
english: *Laid by Voss who asked, of Eldhythe, True Man of the harbour battery, that was raised in his grandmother's harbour-house on the quay.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Tessym tessyl lo et odh sy hy fedh sell.
english: Give me the stone. I have owed this hearth an answer a long while.

label: Romanisation
rom: Virr lo rask et grem hosast, re lammom memm um et lern rerddhalden, ul vimm stell, hy vodh nath mellor paskard et trun lo ull. Amm re yalar tevath, re hyler et bunth olen um et tavow, somm re hunnerent et tevath lyss. Et tolm dasken umo, re hadhom o, en sost.
english: Near the end of the first winter I buried a friend on the east face, under a cairn, for the ground there will not take a spade. As boys we had turned the rope together on the quay, while the little ones jumped. The last stone on him I laid myself.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew Yory o voll.
english: His name was Jory.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et vess ull re vessym pessyl lo et vorr sy. Re yalom brid, eth re haeverym o hosen pessyl duss.
english: That night at this fire I asked a question. Cold I was, and I meant it hard.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy vodh gorrar dem dolm eth crest?
english: "Wherefore fight we for ice and stone?"

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos fedh re runn Stannard um et odhdholm, eth re dhess o lom.
english: Once on the hearthstone knocked Stannard, and answered me.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nel et crest sa yorrom demo.
english: "It is not the ice I fight for."

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew ull tessyl gell, veth ew o dhessyl. En dessyl, re rytym o lo dhrenn et gorrol tunn.
english: That was a good answer, but it was his. Mine hath taken me the whole war to cut.

label: Romanisation
rom: El hyll niss tessyl niss, hosen re wrodh en scaelur o lom: mellor o um et tolmath sost pawast.
english: A slow answer is a slow tide, so my grandmother told it me: it cometh in over the same stones.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vosk o ul et dynd ul sestow et Ternil, et Kethow tunn ul et parow ul vimm et covv treskat. Re stonom ul lodh et kesteth ul et spenn sulven, eth Yory lo en sest. Hos fedh ul o hossenyth nath re yal o ul hossvellyl. Re ston et Crenn lo ol sest, eth et hulter ul o yorn.
english: It began the week after the Rite, the whole Keep in the ward under the torn cloak. I stood among the companies in the slush, and Jory at my shoulder. For once in his life he was not whistling. The Captain stood with us, and the staff in its corner.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yyst Kael Nydherd et tolmath ommat lo et ganna. Re yal hos galat lo, eth re vysk o hos fedh.
english: Kael the Counter climbed the fallen stones by the gate. One thing had he to say, and he said it once.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yorr et Ketherd.
english: "The Commander fought."

label: Romanisation
rom: Eth re dhunn et Stonwrytan tunn o, ul hos carm, hy Idrenna dem et tev lyss sost sa re lymm et nynth:
english: And the whole guild ended it, in one voice, from {{Idrenna}} down to the least child that carried its water:

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yald et Stonwrytan.
english: "The Stonewrights built."

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew ull et brodan tunn. Re yal loskat. Re vesker hos um ullen, hesperd eth tolmard. New pa lunt ol, sa re saede kaelir. Ew hos ol, hosen kyle pa dhrenn ul hos hald amm rhyn et lodh.
english: That was all the speech there was. It was enough. We looked at one another, soldier and mason. We were not two peoples sharing a ruin. One were we, as two courses become one wall when the mortar taketh.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et orl ull re hadhar voll et Kethow um et gaed. El Kethow Dhresk et cummath kethet lo et wemmeth myst, eth el cless et Kethow cless et wadh. El ryt o.
english: That day we laid the Keep's name on the land. Every haven the grey sails hold is Rivenkeep, and the edge of the sea is the edge of the Keep. It is a vow.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vollar ol sost Treskan. Ol nedheth, vollar so: Orrowan, hy vodh ew Orrowan so; eth vollar ol sost: ol. Ul et parow ull re vosk o.
english: We named ourselves the Rivenmen. Our fathers we call Shorelanders, for so they were, and ourselves but *we*. In that ward it began.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn et orl ull re orrar dem susk, hos eth hos, dem et tolm ul vimm et hagess. Re hadh gor hos garl umo, eth re ryt o, hosen byskent uldath so wunthath um et tavow ul hedh. Re orr Yory dem susk ul lern, eth re orr o dem vimm ul hossvellyl. Amm re vellor et vess, re yal et Kethow kethet.
english: All that day we went up one by one to the stone under the pike. Each laid a hand on it and sware, as men make fast their ropes on the quay at evening. Jory went up ere me, and came down whistling. By dark the Keep was held.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ryter: Es gether pawast gor dholm. Nel hos tolm sa nath re yal lor. Veth gor hos sa re yal.
english: We sware to take back every stone. Not one stone that was not ours. But every one that was.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nafedh re vallant et hemmeth sost et voll clenn, eth re vyskent nayalat. Medhent tul ul so naevalath: Orrow.
english: The eldest never liked the new name, and said naught. Into their shawls they murmur "the Shorelands" yet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et grem sy, amm re reskent et noth scethel strom ul et cummath hosen nasath ul et venth, re vessym Ebba hemm hy Sedhnell hy vodh keth ey o. Nath re vesk ey dem susk hy et vorr, veth re heth ey garlath demo.
english: This winter, when the ten great hulls had sat down in the havens like herons in the shallows, I asked old Ebba of Fenholm wherefore she kept it. She looked not up from the fire, but held her hands to it.

label: Romanisation
rom: El voll dem mymmyl o, amm es ston et hald dasken, eth es firr et Crenn Myst dasken cresket.
english: "It is a name to come home to, when the last wall shall stand, and the last Mystarch lie broken."

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo et vorr, nel lom, re vysk ey hos brod tul.
english: To the fire and not to me she said one word more.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nayess.
english: "Perhaps."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re hyrrilym o amm ull. Kaeverym: hyrrilym amm sy.
english: I did not understand it then. I think I do now.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lern et gemm vess sy, re resk ey desir um et prenthrask ull, virr sost lo et kesketh, eth ey naeval dem et biskyann. Re orrar dem ol naevalath, eth re luskar ey ul naedh. Ul et vess re vorr et odhvorr dem vimm, eth re hlenn nahos o.
english: Four nights since, she sat late on that bench-end, nearest the coals, her shawl to her chin. We went to our blankets and left her sleeping. In the night the fire burned down, and no one mended it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et ryst nath re rynn ey.
english: In the morning she did not wake.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hedh re hadhar ey um et lern rerddhalden lo et hesperdeth. Re vyske Idrenna et ammelyl dem muldath sennet, saed eth saed. Re hadh Marl, tev ey tev, et tolm dasken. Umo re vysk o et voll hemm: Orrow. Re hyl nahos hyor o. Re wysk et Crenn saedel hy o hovv um hagess umoy.
english: At dusk we laid her on the east face by the soldiers. {{Idrenna}} said the prayer for the dead in two halves. Marl, her grandson, laid the last stone. Over it he said the old name, "the Shorelands." None of us corrected him. The Captain bound a strip of his half-cloak on a pike above her.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew ey sa re hebb o dhessyl lo et odh sy. Virr gor vess re hadh ey o dholm hosast, hos hoss ul lern et ullen. Ul et gemm vess sy doss lunn ul o lern, ryssyth hos carm hemm. Re raevul nahos hyor dem o loskol.
english: It was she that gave this hearth its answer. Most nights she began it, a breath before the rest. These four nights there hath been a space at the front of it, the width of one old voice. None of us have tried to fill it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy, doss en dessyl lo sy, eth doss o nydhyl los. Yory, sa re vessym o demo, nafedh re hunn o et pessyl.
english: Now here is mine, and ye may weigh it. Jory, for whose sake I asked it, never heard it asked.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et hald rerddhalden re vyskym hos fedh:
english: On the east wall I said once:

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath norrar hy vodh el venn ol. Gorrar hy vodh doss ol devath ul sestow et haldath sy.
english: "We do not fight because we are right. We fight because our children are behind these walls."

label: Romanisation
rom: El venn o, veth nel o tunn. Nath noss tev lom, en sost; veth re vyskym: ol.
english: It is true, but not the whole of it. Child have I none of mine own, and yet I said *our*.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et taldow rerddhalden doss veskyl et kethowath sa re yaldar ul et gorrol sy los, hosen gannath lo dhrenn tavow, eth gever lorr umo, gor hos. Veth nath dovvar ul gethow dem et dask. Doss o dem morrol hyo.
english: From the east tower ye may see the keeps we raised in this war, like posts along a quay, a crimson pennant on every one. But a keep is no place to stay in for ever. It is a place to go out from.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath norrar dem dolm eth crest. El Kethow Dhresk gor dholm hyo, eth el varn Kethow Dhresk, eth re ryter um et movenn: Es lymmer o dem varn.
english: We fight not for ice and stone. Every stone of it is Rivenkeep, and Rivenkeep is home, and on the banner we sware to bring it home.

label: Romanisation
rom: Tovv Ebba hemm um et lern rerddhalden. Keth Marl et tolm sa re lymm ey hy Sedhnell ul o havul.
english: Old Ebba bideth on the east face. Marl hath in his pack the stone she bare out of Fenholm.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ryst orrar dem vimm dem et cummath.
english: Tomorrow we go down to the havens.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re dhovv et odh hoss Ebba.
english: *The hearth waited a breath for Ebba.*

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
